threat_event: Ransomware encrypts the cloud TOS, gate servers and office systems at both terminals and the depot, stopping vessel, yard and gate operations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standing domain administrator accounts; T2 flat network; TOS restore took 6.5 h against a 4 h RTO; failover to the standby region never tested; T2 gate server images not backed up
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-02; SYS-08; SYS-10; BP-01 to BP-12
sp800_53_controls: CP-9; CP-10; CP-4; AC-6; SC-7; SI-4
existing_controls: MFA for all identity provider users and the VPN; EDR with 24x7 MSSP; write-once backups in a separate account; warm standby replica; T1 OT zone
treatment_plan: Privileged access management for directory, identity provider and TOS administrators; T2 OT zone; tested TOS failover and hourly isolated snapshots; T2 gate image backups; ransomware runbook exercised (P08)
exposure_estimate_usd: $2M-$5M (72-hour two-terminal outage about $0.8M plus response, recovery, legal and carrier penalties; insurance limit $15M, retention $500K)

threat_event: Attacker moves from the T2 gate and office network into mobile harbor crane controllers and VMTs on the same flat network and causes unsafe motion or a stoppage
threat_source: Cybercriminal group or state-linked actor targeting ports
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No IT/OT segmentation at T2; IT-OT connections at T2 not logged or monitored (gap 1)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03 at T2; SYS-07; BP-05; BP-06
existing_controls: Site firewall at the T2 internet edge; EDR on Windows gate servers; crane operators in the cab with safety interlocks
treatment_plan: Build a T2 OT zone behind an industrial firewall matching T1; passive OT monitoring sensors at T2 with alerts to the MSSP
exposure_estimate_usd: $500K-$2M (T2 stoppage of several days, equipment damage, injury exposure)

threat_event: Compromise of the T2 mobile harbor crane OEM cellular appliance (always on, shared account, no MFA) gives an attacker direct access to crane controllers
threat_source: Cybercriminal or state-linked actor; OEM insider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on remote access that bypasses every firewall; shared vendor account; sessions not approved, monitored or recorded (gap 2)
existing_controls: Appliance installed under the OEM service contract; crane safety interlocks
treatment_plan: Power the appliance off except for approved sessions from 2026-10-15; move OEM support to the privileged remote access service with named accounts, MFA and recording
exposure_estimate_usd: $300K-$1.5M (crane damage or injury; T2 vessel delays)

threat_event: The TOS database is encrypted or corrupted, the corruption replicates to the standby region, and restoring from the daily write-once backup exceeds the RTO and loses up to 24 hours of moves
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Failover never tested; 2026-04-22 restore took 6.5 h against a 4 h RTO; only daily isolated backups (gap 5)
existing_controls: Daily backups with 35-day write-once retention and separate credentials; continuous standby replica
treatment_plan: Failover test 2026-11-07; hourly isolated snapshots; restore runbook tuned to meet 4 h; quarterly restore tests
exposure_estimate_usd: $400K-$1.2M (extra day of manual working at both terminals plus a physical yard check)

threat_event: A cyber incident is not reported immediately to the FBI, CISA and the Captain of the Port, delaying the coordinated response and creating a compliance finding
threat_source: Workforce unaware of the reporting line
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Reporting step never exercised; T2 supervisors do not know the internal reporting line (P07 IR-6)
existing_controls: P08 notification matrix; CySO 24x7 rota
treatment_plan: Reporting step in every cyber drill; wallet cards with the CySO line for supervisors and longshore foremen

threat_event: The Cybersecurity Plan is not ready for submission by 2027-07-16, or is returned by the Coast Guard, because the Assessment and OT inventory are incomplete
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT inventory about 55% complete; 15 gaps open; one CySO covering two COTP zones
existing_controls: CySO and alternate designated 2026-03-02; Plan project plan approved
treatment_plan: Assessment complete 2027-03-31; Plan draft 2027-04-30; pre-submission meeting with both COTPs 2027-Q1; submission 2027-05-28

threat_event: Untrained longshore workers or vendor technicians plug in unknown media, follow social engineering, or mishandle VMTs and HMIs
threat_source: Phishing and social engineering actors; accidental misuse
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 42 employees trained late; longshore labor and vendor technicians not trained; no supervision rule (gap 7)
existing_controls: Subpart F training for 548 employees by 2026-01-12; annual phishing simulation (6.1% click rate)
treatment_plan: One-page rules card through the hiring halls; vendor technician briefing at sign-in; supervision rule in POL-05; OT training at T2

threat_event: Attacker uses default passwords on reefer monitoring gateways or OCR camera controllers to change settings or pivot
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default passwords on 4 T1 reefer gateways and 2 T2 OCR camera controllers (P07 IA-5); no compensating controls documented
existing_controls: Reefer gateways inside the T1 OT zone
treatment_plan: Change all default passwords; commissioning checklist requiring password change before go-live; quarterly default-credential scan

threat_event: Privileged account takeover outside the cloud (directory, identity provider or TOS administration) gives domain-wide control
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 standing domain administrator accounts; privileged access management covers the cloud only; administrators use push MFA (gap 3)
existing_controls: MFA for all administrators; just-in-time elevation in the cloud
treatment_plan: Privileged access management for directory, identity provider and TOS administrators; phishing-resistant MFA (FIDO2) for administrators; tiered administration

threat_event: A known exploited vulnerability is used against end-of-support T2 OCR servers or 2 T2 crane HMIs, which cannot be patched or quickly rebuilt
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Operating systems past end of vendor support; no backup images; flat T2 network (gap 11)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02 and SYS-03 at T2; BP-06; BP-07
existing_controls: EDR on the OCR servers; site firewall
treatment_plan: Replace the T2 OCR servers and 2 HMIs (funded for 2027-Q1); compensating controls until then: isolation behind a temporary firewall rule and an allow list

threat_event: A known exploited vulnerability in the internet-facing VPN, firewalls or portal is exploited before it is patched
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 of 21 KEVs in 2026 H1 missed the 7-day target; OT and T2 gate systems not scanned
existing_controls: Weekly KEV review; monthly authenticated scans of IT
treatment_plan: KEV target of 72 hours for internet-facing systems; emergency change path; scan OT passively and T2 gate systems monthly

threat_event: An insider or organized crime manipulates container release or hold status in the TOS to steal cargo or move contraband
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Customs hold overrides reviewed only daily; TOS application audit log not in the SIEM; separation of duties weak for the 5 TOS application staff
existing_controls: Daily hold override report reviewed by superintendents; TOS role matrix
treatment_plan: Two-person approval for hold overrides; TOS audit log to the SIEM with alerts on overrides; separate TOS code release from administration
exposure_estimate_usd: $100K-$1M per theft event plus customs penalties

threat_event: A former employee or a transferred employee uses a TOS gate module local account that was not removed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: TOS gate module local accounts outside the identity provider (P07: 6 of 25 sampled leavers kept them); 3 of 25 transfers kept prior roles
existing_controls: Identity provider disabled automatically at termination
treatment_plan: Move gate module accounts into the identity provider; quarterly access reviews; transfer workflow removes prior roles

threat_event: Shared OT engineering and HMI accounts are misused and a controller change cannot be traced to a person
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared accounts on crane engineering workstations and HMIs at both terminals; 4-digit HMI PINs; no compensating controls documented (gap 3)
existing_controls: Physical access to crane cabs and electrical houses; T1 OT monitoring
treatment_plan: Named engineering accounts; documented compensating controls for HMIs where unique IDs are not feasible; change log reconciled with OT monitoring

threat_event: A hurricane closes both terminals and damages the T1 gate server room or its power
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: T1 gate server room at ground level; generator covers the server room for 48 hours; no tested recovery of gate servers elsewhere
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02 at T1; SYS-07; BP-02; BP-03
existing_controls: Cloud TOS unaffected by local damage; port hurricane plan; FSP procedures
treatment_plan: Raise the T1 gate server rack; spare gate server image held in the cloud; pre-season hurricane checklist each June

threat_event: Loss of the single T2 internet and SD-WAN circuit cuts the T2 gate and yard off from the cloud TOS
threat_source: Carrier fiber cut or provider outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single circuit at T2 and the depot; T1 has dual circuits
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-07 at T2 and the depot; BP-06; BP-07; BP-11
existing_controls: Cellular backup router at T2 (limited bandwidth)
treatment_plan: Second diverse circuit at T2; tested failover to cellular for the gate lanes

threat_event: After an incident, T2 cannot be rebuilt within its RTO because gate server images are not backed up and mobile harbor crane PLC programs are held only by the OEM
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: T2 gate server images not backed up; T2 PLC programs only with the OEM; no T2 rebuild procedure (gap 5)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02 and SYS-03 at T2; BP-06; BP-07
existing_controls: OEM keeps program copies under the service contract
treatment_plan: Weekly T2 gate server images to the backup account; T2 PLC programs and HMI settings held offline by the company; T2 rebuild test

threat_event: A compromised OCR or reefer monitoring vendor remote support tool is used to reach gate servers or reefer gateways
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendors use their own remote tools outside the privileged remote access service; sessions not monitored (gap 2)
existing_controls: Vendor access limited to named servers by firewall rules at T1
treatment_plan: Onboard all 27 vendors with access to the privileged remote access service; remove vendor-installed tools

threat_event: The customs data exchange service is unavailable or sends corrupted release and hold status, so the gates stop or held containers are released
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single provider; release and hold messages get syntax checks only; no plan for its loss (P07 CP-2)
existing_controls: Clerks can check status in the provider web portal; gate stops rather than guesses
treatment_plan: Business-rule checks on release changes; reconciliation report; documented loss-of-service procedure

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects a carrier, customer or vendor payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank detail changes verified by email only at T2 (acquired processes)
existing_controls: MFA on email; callback verification at headquarters
treatment_plan: One callback procedure company-wide; banking change holds in the ERP

threat_event: An attacker deletes T2 gate server or TOS application logs, so the incident cannot be investigated or evidenced to the Coast Guard
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: T2 gate server and TOS application logs are local and deletable by local administrators (P07 AU-9)
existing_controls: SIEM holds identity, cloud, firewall, EDR, portal and T1 gate logs for 1 year
treatment_plan: Forward T2 gate and TOS application logs to the SIEM and locked bucket under STD-03

threat_event: Malware enters a T2 HMI, gate server or kiosk on USB media or a technician laptop
threat_source: Malware carried by staff or vendors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: USB and unused ports open on T2 HMIs, gate servers and kiosks (gap 13); no allowlisting
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02 and SYS-03 at T2; BP-06; BP-07
existing_controls: Port blockers at T1; EDR on Windows servers
treatment_plan: Port blockers and media scanning kiosk at T2; allowlisting on gate servers

threat_event: An unauthorized person enters the T2 gate server room or a crane electrical house and tampers with equipment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: T2 rooms keyed alike with no access log; no camera on the T2 gate server room door (P07 PE-3)
existing_controls: TWIC access control at the terminal gate; patrols
treatment_plan: Badge readers and a camera on the T2 gate server room; key control log for electrical houses

threat_event: CCTV cameras or the video management server are compromised and used as a foothold or to blind the FSO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: T2 cameras on the flat network; camera firmware patched irregularly
existing_controls: Video management servers behind the site firewall at T1
treatment_plan: Accepted as Low by the Director of Port Security until the T2 OT zone (R-002) separates security systems; firmware review each quarter

threat_event: An unknown internet-exposed OT device (for example a cellular modem on a crane or reefer rack) is found and exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT about 55% inventoried; T2 not inventoried; no network map (gap 4)
existing_controls: T1 passive OT monitoring discovers T1 devices
treatment_plan: Complete OT inventory at both terminals; external attack surface scan monthly; consolidated network map

threat_event: An OT intrusion at T1 is detected late because OT monitoring alerts go to an analyst queue reviewed on business days only
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: T1 OT alerts outside the MSSP 24x7 workflow (gap 9)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03 at T1; SYS-13; BP-01; BP-05
existing_controls: Passive OT sensors at T1; OT-focused analyst on day shift
treatment_plan: Route OT alerts to the MSSP with an OT escalation playbook

threat_event: A customer portal vulnerability is exploited to read driver details or manipulate truck appointments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No static analysis or security test plan; development contractor can merge to production (P07 SA-11)
existing_controls: Web application firewall; peer review; dependency scanning; 2026-06 external test
treatment_plan: Static analysis in the pipeline; branch protection with company approval for production; annual portal penetration test

threat_event: The scheduling optimization service (AI-001) recommends an unsafe or infeasible berth or yard plan that a planner approves without catching the problem
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Only planner vigilance stops constraint violations; vendor not given crane maintenance status (P10)
existing_controls: Advisory mode only; planner approval in the TOS
treatment_plan: Independent constraint check in the TOS; equipment status feed; reason codes for overrides (P10 conditions)

threat_event: The scheduling model systematically gives some carriers or trucking companies worse berth windows or appointment slots without an operational reason
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No fairness monitoring before P10; appointment slot pilot showed a gap by fleet size
existing_controls: Appointment slots allocated by customer service
treatment_plan: Quarterly fairness tests; complaints logged against the model (P10)

threat_event: During a TOS outage no one can produce the current location of hazardous cargo for emergency responders
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The dangerous cargo location list exists only in the TOS
existing_controls: FSP emergency procedures; port fire department pre-plans
treatment_plan: Printed dangerous cargo location list at each shift change at both security offices; included in cyber drills

threat_event: During a T1 gate outage the manual gate runs at about 25% of capacity and trucks back up onto port roads, so the port authority closes the approach
threat_source: Gate system outage of any cause
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual gate handles about 50 transactions an hour against peaks of about 190; release lists not pre-printed
existing_controls: Manual gate procedure on 3 lanes
treatment_plan: Pre-staged paper interchange forms and an hourly release list export to the gate complex; manual gate drill twice a year
exposure_estimate_usd: $35K-$150K per day plus port authority penalties

threat_event: A security researcher or partner reports a vulnerability and the report is lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No channel to receive publicly reported vulnerabilities (gap 15)
existing_controls: General contact form on the website
treatment_plan: Published vulnerability disclosure address and security.txt on the portal; triage in STD-07

threat_event: Bay plans and status messages sent by plain FTP to 2 carrier services are read or altered in transit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 carrier services still use plain FTP (gap 12)
existing_controls: IP allow list on the FTP endpoint
treatment_plan: Move both carrier services to SFTP or AS2 and retire FTP

threat_event: An identity provider outage stops sign-in to the TOS, portal administration, email and cloud administration at both terminals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single identity provider; gate clerks depend on it after the gate module accounts move in
existing_controls: Provider SOC 2 Type 2 with availability commitments; cached sessions; break-glass accounts for the cloud
treatment_plan: Break-glass accounts for the TOS and gate servers; offline gate sign-in mode tested with the TOS vendor

threat_event: Personal information of truck drivers or employees is exfiltrated, triggering Florida breach notices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Driver license numbers in the TOS gate module; employee data in HR SaaS and file shares; no egress alerting on gate servers
existing_controls: Portal tokenizes driver license numbers; encryption at rest in the cloud
treatment_plan: Purge driver license numbers from the gate module after 90 days; egress alerting; data inventory
exposure_estimate_usd: $200K-$1M (notices, counsel, credit monitoring for up to about 20,000 drivers)

threat_event: SSI (FSPs, FSAs, network maps, this register) is disclosed to persons without a need to know, for example in email to vendors or in open file shares
threat_source: Accidental disclosure by staff or vendors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SSI marking and storage rules not applied to cyber documents; vendors receive diagrams without SSI terms
existing_controls: FSPs held by the FSOs in locked storage
treatment_plan: SSI handling standard (STD-10); SSI-restricted repository; SSI terms in vendor contracts

threat_event: The TOS vendor remote support path or a TOS software update is compromised and used to reach the TOS (supply chain attack)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: TOS vendor has standing support access through a VPN account; update packages not verified independently
existing_controls: TOS vendor SOC 2 Type 2; MFA on the vendor VPN account; 72-hour contractual incident notice
treatment_plan: Move TOS vendor support to the privileged remote access service with per-session approval; verify update hashes; test updates in staging

threat_event: The MSSP misses or delays escalation of a high-severity alert
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contract requires a call within 30 minutes; no monthly SLA review
existing_controls: MSSP SOC 2 Type 2; monthly report
treatment_plan: Accepted as Low by the Security Manager; SLA tracked monthly from 2026-10

threat_event: Staff paste SSI, customs status or personal information into an unapproved generative AI tool
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two AI tools adopted by departments without review; no AI policy until 2026-09 (gap 14)
existing_controls: Enterprise generative AI assistant under contract (AI-005)
treatment_plan: AI use standard (STD-09); block unapproved AI sites on company devices; training

threat_event: Unapproved software or firmware runs on gate or OT systems, or their configuration drifts from a secure baseline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No approved list for OT and gate systems; no hardening standard for gate servers; executable code not disabled by default (gap 10)
existing_controls: Server build guide for TOS and T1 gate servers
treatment_plan: Configuration standard STD-05 with an approved list; allowlisting on gate servers; OT baseline from the passive sensors

threat_event: A vendor learns of a vulnerability or incident affecting the company but does not notify it, or notifies it too late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 of 27 vendors with access have no notification clause; vendors reviewed only at onboarding (gap 8)
existing_controls: Notification clauses with 13 of 27 vendors (TOS vendor 72 hours; MSSP 30 minutes)
treatment_plan: Contract amendments for the 14 vendors; annual review of vendors with access (STD-04; P09)

threat_event: Responders do not know how to contain an OT incident safely, so cranes stay down longer or are restarted while compromised
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2024 IR plan has no OT procedures; T2 has had no cyber scenario; only 1 cyber drill in 2026 (gap 6)
existing_controls: P08 OT vendor access runbook approved 2026-09-15
treatment_plan: Cyber Incident Response Plan with OT procedures; second 2026 drill on 2026-11-18 with a T2 crane scenario

threat_event: The carrier alliance (3 services, about 45% of T1 revenue) does not renew in 2027 because the company cannot deliver a clean SOC 2 Type 2 report on the portal and EDI services
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SOC 2 readiness gaps in access reviews, recovery testing, vendor oversight and change management (P09)
existing_controls: Readiness assessment complete; executive sponsorship by the COO
treatment_plan: SOC 2 remediation plan; Type 1 report by 2027-03-31; Type 2 observation period 2027-04-01 to 2027-09-30
exposure_estimate_usd: About $34M a year of revenue at risk; $3M-$10M margin impact

threat_event: Gate OCR (AI-002) misreads a container or plate number and a container is released to the wrong truck
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Misread rate not measured since 2025
existing_controls: Clerk resolves every misread; customs hold check in the TOS
treatment_plan: Accepted as Low by the Vice President, Terminal Operations, with a misread-rate review by 2026-12-31 (P10)

threat_event: The crane predictive maintenance analytics connector (AI-003) creates an outbound path from the crane management system to the vendor cloud that an attacker could use
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Outbound connector installed by the vendor in 2026 without a security review; connection crosses the T1 OT zone firewall
existing_controls: T1 OT zone firewall allows only the vendor endpoint
treatment_plan: Security review and data terms; one-way data export through a data diode or brokered push; vendor SOC 2 report (P10)

threat_event: Perimeter video analytics (AI-004) misses an intrusion or causes alarm fatigue, and a person reaches a restricted area undetected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: False alarm rate not measured; no review of missed detections
existing_controls: Security officer patrols; CCTV recorded 30 days
treatment_plan: Monthly detection and false alarm metrics; quarterly walk test at T1 (P10)

threat_event: A port community system API key is stolen and used to send false vessel schedules or gate status
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Static API keys; no interconnection security terms with the port authorities (P02 CA-3)
existing_controls: TLS; message validation against the TOS vessel schedule
treatment_plan: Accepted as Low by the Vice President, Terminal Operations; keys rotated each year; security terms at lease renewal

threat_event: A change of ownership or another terminal acquisition requires a new Cybersecurity Assessment and Plan amendments, and the acquired site repeats the T2 integration gaps
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: T2 integration still incomplete two years after acquisition; no security integration playbook
existing_controls: PE sponsor informed of Subpart F duties
treatment_plan: Security integration playbook for acquisitions; ownership change checklist for the FSOs and the CySO

threat_event: A VMT on the yard Wi-Fi is compromised and used to reach the yard network or send false job instructions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: VMTs run a vendor-locked operating system without EDR; T2 VMT Wi-Fi on the flat network
existing_controls: WPA2-Enterprise at T1 with certificates; T1 VMT Wi-Fi in the OT zone
treatment_plan: Certificate-based Wi-Fi at T2 in the new OT zone; VMT firmware review with the vendor

threat_event: An attacker already inside the T1 OT zone sends commands over unencrypted OT protocols to cranes or the reefer system
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT protocols unencrypted with no documented feasibility review (gap 12)
existing_controls: T1 OT zone firewall; passive OT monitoring
treatment_plan: Feasibility review of OT protocol encryption recorded in the Plan; protocol allow lists and alerting on write commands

threat_event: Departure of the CySO or the OT-focused analyst leaves Subpart F duties and OT monitoring without coverage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Small team (24 IT and cybersecurity staff; 1 OT analyst); CySO duties concentrated in one person with one alternate
existing_controls: Alternate CySO designated; vCISO contract
treatment_plan: Accepted as Low by the Chief Operating Officer; cross-training plan reviewed each year
